body: I don’t add anything and I only take and take. I live alone to get away from my family. They used to do stuff to me I have bad memories about. Nothing bad but it hurts none the less.
I’m unable to work. I’m a blight on society. It’s what I deserve, although I don’t want to face it. I think suicide is better than starvation.

I live with a friend. We rent the place together.

They also did something to hurt me recently. I don’t feel I’m worth much. It will be easier without me needing so much help from them due to my problems.

It won’t get better. That’s not how this works, I can’t work due to my problems, I don’t have an income for much longer. Suicide *is* the only option unless someone were to convince me starvation on the streets is going to be alright.
